name: SSO Authentication
overview: Authenticate users against an SSO provider (OIDC/SAML).
description: This plugin allows users to sign in through an SSO provider (such as Authelia, authentik, Keycloak, Google) via OpenID Connect or SAML. This is the Jellyfin 12.x adapted fork, maintained by flyzstu (based on the archived 9p4/jellyfin-plugin-sso).

versions.changelog: 将 SSO 设置页加入左侧主菜单插件分组（'SSO设置'）。

Adapted to Jellyfin 12.x (.NET 10):

- retarget net9.0 → **net10.0**(服务端 12.2 为 net10.0,10.11 插件无法在 12.x 加载)
- Jellyfin.Controller / Jellyfin.Model 10.11.0 → **12.2.0**(ExcludeAssets=runtime,对齐官方插件模板)
- manifest targetAbi → **12.0.0.0**(兼容 Jellyfin 12.0–12.2+)
- 移除 System.Security.Cryptography.Xml 包引用(.NET 10 运行时已内置,顺带消除 Pkcs 6.0.1 高危传递依赖)
- Newtonsoft.Json 13.0.3 → 13.0.4(与服务器一致)
- Web 端完成页 appVersion → 12.2.0

基于已归档的 9p4/jellyfin-plugin-sso,由本 fork 维护。
安装:控制台 → 插件 → 存储库 添加 `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flyzstu/jellyfin-plugin-sso/artifacts/manifest.json`
Fix security issue in SAML (last upstream 9p4 release, for Jellyfin 10.11).
